notes.title: Update 0.5 - The End of the Journey!
notes.content:
[h2]Added:[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Chapter 10! Find out the final story of The Forked Road! The answers to many questions, including the cause of the cataclysm, are already waiting for you! [/b]
[/list]
[h2]Fixed or changed:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Many visual fixes in Chapters 7, 8, and 9
[*] Added Spanish, German, and French translations
[*] More loot in Chapters 5, 6, and 9
[*] Fixed tree collision in Chapter 9
[*] Fixed a bug with taking damage from ghost arrows.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed you to move very fast in stealth mode
[*] The Time Bomb can now be disassembled.
[*] The karma system now takes into account which trap killed enemies. Your trap, or the one that was already on damage.
[*] Changes to Crafting Recipes
[/list]

[h1]But that's not all![/h1]
[h2]Even though the journey is over, updates will still be coming.
I will now focus on improving the visuals of the game, maybe even a voiceover will appear. Also, the world of TFR will expand a bit more. At least chapters 5, 7, and 8 will have additional walkthrough options. 
Thanks for being here all this time. And stay in touch! [/h2] [/h2]

notes.title: Chapter 9 and plans for the future!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey, everybody![/h1]
[h2]It's been a while since I've been in touch. But don't worry, the development of the game continues![/h2]
[h3]Update 0.4 will be released soon, which includes a new chapter that will bring you one step closer to the final story. In addition to the new chapter, there will be a lot of visual improvements, bug fixes and much more!
I'll post a more specific update plan later, but for now check out the first screenshot of chapter 9![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41964878/51a37ea77f28375406e25e80e6a617a0d519e5d0.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.35
notes.content:
[h2]Added: [/h2]
[list]
[*] Photo mode! Photo mode has been added to the game. Press "P" during the game to activate it. 
[*] Glossary. A database of the world and characters you meet along the way has been added to the game. There is not too much data there now, but the glossary will be updated in the future.
[*] Character Menu. The journal window has been completely redesigned. Now it consists of 3 items: Journal, Glossary and Character. In the character menu you can see the list of learned skills, see the character's characteristics and change the cloak. In the future this menu will have other functions.
[/list]
[h2]Changed or fixed: [/h2]
[list]
[*] Almost all of the vegetation in the game has been changed to a more appropriate style.
[*] Removed the cloak menu, now the button to change cloak is in the "character" menu
[*] Fixed various bugs, including UI bugs
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.32
notes.content:
[h3][b]Added:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The stun bomb has a new property. Now the blast wave from the bomb affects characters and some objects in the world. These objects can stun or even kill enemies on contact.
[*] Slightly updated chapter 8 
[/list]
[h3][b]Fixed or changed:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Hostile NPCs no longer react to projectile fragments. (And they don't fly off into the sky :) )
[*] Сharacter no longer dies when moving from chapter 7 to chapter 8
[*] Fixed a bug that made it impossible to craft a stun bomb
[*] Fixed a bug that caused some interface elements to not disappear if they were on the screen when the tooltip appeared
[*] The patrolling speed of enemies on many levels has been rebalanced
[*] Fixed a bug that would not allow you to save if you re-run a chapter.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.31
notes.content:

notes.content:

[*] Interactive objects - now you can interact with some objects. Move and climb crates, push wagons and hit enemies with them!
[*] New skill - Burning light
[*] New skill - Silent step
[*] New item - Stun bomb
[*] New Item - Clock Bomb
[*] New equipment - portable workbench
[/list]

[h2]Fixed or changed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved crossbowmen AI
[*] The lock pick blueprint must now be found
[*] The karma system has been redone. Now each individual character has a different opinion of you

notes.title: Update 0.26
notes.content:

notes.title: Update 0.25
notes.content:
[h1]It so happened that the version 0.24 bypassed the main branch of the game and appeared only in the demo.
Demo at the moment stays on version 0.24, and the main version goes straight to 0.25
So what's new?[/h1]
[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*] New level - Riverport prison! Chapter 5 is now available in two options. Instead of the sawmill and the town of Riverport, you can now go through Riverport Prison and its surroundings. To get to Riverport Prison, you must exit the town in Chapter 4 through an underground tunnel, or go out through a gate and in Chapter 5 find a cave that will lead you to the prison gate.
[*] New UI! - Many interface elements have been updated. The main HUD, the crafting window, the main menu, etc.
In addition, updated the display of the projectile trajectory
[*] Updated intro level. The intro now looks much better, and also includes a larger stealth section
[*] 3D goal widgets - Now after receiving a new task, for a while you will be able to see the 3D widget which indicates the place you need to get to and the distance to it. This widget is only visible permanently if you are holding a lantern
[*] Added 2 new achievements
[/list]
[b]Changed or fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Various changes in chapters 1, 4, 5, 6
[*] Small corrections to the Spanish, English, and German translations
[*] Various balance changes. The weight of some items has been changed, as well as the amount of loot at levels
[*] Added ability to climb some ledges in stealth mode
[/list]
Stay tuned! There are more interesting things to come!

notes.title: Update 0.23
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, everyone!
This update doesn't add much new, but it fixes a lot of bugs. Hopefully now your walkthrough will be much more comfortable![/h1]

[h2]Added:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added option to limit FPS in settings
[*] Maps. You can now find location maps. At the moment there are maps only in chapter 3 and 6. They are static and quite "raw". But I think even in this form they will make your life easier :)
[*] You can  now interrupt a rune by pressing RMB while it is being used.
[*] Additional save point in chapter 5
[/list]

[h2]Fixed or changed:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [h3][b]Improved enemy AI![/b][/h3]  Now when you sneak and get in range of the enemy, he will notice you not immediately. Once you are in range, the enemy will walk in your direction. If you are in his line of sight when he reaches the target - then he will see you.
[*] Fixed the "Cat's Eyes" skill
[*] Fixed lighting in chapter 2
[*] Crossbow bolts now do not pass through walls and are slowed down while using the time rune.
[*] Audio settings are now saved correctly
[*] Chapters 1 and 5 have been improved
[*] Fixed the option to replay a chapter
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.22
notes.content:
[h2]Added:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [h3]New secret location in chapter 6[/h3]
[*] [h3]Quick slots [/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41964878/45546a1833095a5d39dab3d85df1cf5fecb09b35.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41964878/889e508de7f7fbd491d13a377880e3c1760421d1.png[/img][/url] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41964878/dd5b022321f216acb1e28d69eac745f137f274d2.png[/img] If you upgrade your backpack, you get extra slots in the quick menu. You can use any items thanks to these slots. Right now it's mostly food, but I'm going to add more usable items in the future.
[*] [h3]Useful Ghosts[/h3] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41964878/60aaa7664f0a4d6442c042a00885282d90a7910e.png[/img] Most of the ghosts in the game are aggressive. However, there will now be more peaceful ones. Some of them go about their business and don't notice you, but some will tell you the location of secret locations and hidden passages.
But such ghosts are only visible when using the ghost rune.
[*] Added animation when picking up items and when crafting equipment
[*] New animations at the residents in chapter 7. Now they're not just standing still, they're doing things! Also added an animation while talking to them.
[*] Now you can dismantle traps
[/list]
[h2]Changed or fixed:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Now you can't control your character while falling
[*] Changed "drop item" window [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41964878/ec7b756e2a67dae6925df8aee762c2f1140029f8.png[/img]
[*] Enemies now die on contact with the trap, only after it is on the ground.
[*] Small changes in the design of the inventory
[*] Updated main menu
[*] Fixed various bugs related to music 
[/list]

notes.title: Demo is available again!
notes.content:
[h2]The Forked Road demo is back![/h2] 
[i][h3]Updated levels, new skills and more![/h3][/i]

notes.title: Future plans
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, everyone!
I hope you're having a good time in the world of The Forked Road!
It's time to tell you what's in store for next year!
[/h1]
[h2]Chapter 8[/h2]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41964878/da1a4245c92726a3653a9049d91f153b5cc4a7a1.png[/img] [b]First, of course, is Chapter 8.[/b] I can't guarantee you that all of the remaining chapters will be out next year, but there definitely will be an eighth! The mountain is getting closer, and so is solving the mystery of the cataclysm. I hope you enjoy it! But before we visit chapter 8...

[h3]Riverport Prison[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41964878/b19b0217670b51d31f028371418401c7a878b9b6.png[/img]
[b]Riverport Prison[/b] will be an alternate version of the passage of chapter 5. You can go through the level in an ABSOLUTELY different way, without even going in and seeing the town of Riverport itself. But you always have a choice...
My plan is for the prison to be the first major update next year.

[h3]New skills[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41964878/fe89017a90e6d67ecb71dfd176f22dab6a7611c4.png[/img]
I think you've already noticed that there are a couple of blocked skills in the skill tree.
I'll be adding new skills soon, and there will probably be more than I originally planned. If you have ideas for new skills, feel free to suggest them!

[h3]New customization options.[/h3]
Right now I'm working on adding the ability to change the color of the main character's clothes. But in the future, I want to add new items of clothing, including holiday themed ones.
[h3]Full gamepad support[/h3]
I'm already taking steps in that direction. You can still play with a gamepad, but it's not very convenient. I don't know when exactly, but I will definitely add full gamepad support to the game.

[b]That's all for now! Thanks for being with me this year and see you in the new year!
Have a great holiday season everyone![/b]

notes.title: The Forked Road 0.2 - Survival Instinct
notes.content:
[h2]Added:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b][h3]Chapter 7 - Welcome to the coast! New discoveries and consequences from past decisions await you here. [/h3][/b]
[*] [b]Hunger[/b] - You now need to keep track of your character's hunger. If you do not quench your hunger, your maximum stamina value will decrease.
[*] [b]Campfires[/b] - Resting by the fire you can do one of several actions: restore health, cook food or temporarily increase your stamina.
[*] [b]New Items[/b]: [i]Carrot, Herbs, Mushroom Soup, Salad, Tea[/i]
[*] [b]New Equipment[/b] - Lockpick Set. Allows you to open any lock with a 100% chance. The blueprint can be found in Chapter 7.
[*] [b]New Cloak[/b] - Can be found in chapter 7
[*] [b]Added music[/b] in chapters 1, 3, 4 and 5
[*] [b]Ability to save on the same checkpoint multiple times[/b]
[/list]
[h2]Changed or fixed:[/h2]
[list]
[*] New leg bandage model
[*] You now need 2 iron bars instead of 4 to create a picklock
[*] Changed description of the ghost rune
[*] Various changes in chapters 1, 3 and 5
[/list]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41964878/6e4b123349668a64bb791aaad43ecc83930137ef.png[/img]
[b][h2]Added:[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] [b]"Knowledge" system[/b] - Look for the notes and gain knowledge from them! The knowledge will open up new answers in the dialogues and help you learn more about the world you destroyed.
[b]Answers added by knowledge will be colored purple[/b]
[*] [b]New UI[/b] - Completely changed the main HUD. Also the crafting interface and inventory have been slightly changed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41964878/b4cb3de9a8ea91868b37efa6bbc40c020b440fc3.png[/img]
[*] Added French language (15%)
[*] More text translated into German and Spanish
[/list]

[b][h2]Fixed or changed:[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Corrections to the English text
[*] Fixed camera shake when jumping over fences
[*] Fixed bug with inability to climb the ladder immediately after building
[*] Other minor fixes
[/list]
[h3][b]Other:[/b][/h3]
You may also notice that the "gamepad" item appeared in the settings. It is currently inactive because the game does not fully support the gamepad. However, you can try playing using gamepad!
The gamepad works in:
[list]
[*] Main menu + settings
[*] Pause menu + settings
[*] Inventory
[*] Craft menu
[/list]
Basic actions such as moving, interacting with objects, and using the lantern are also available with the gamepad.

notes.title: What's next?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41964878/f9d08f3dc5d7ae64bb58b35517d05a2438ec7ca1.png[/img]
[h1]Early Access. What's next?[/h1]
[h2]Hello, everyone! [/h2]
[h3]I want to tell you what to expect in future updates to The Forked Road!
[/h3][list]
[*][b]Сhapter 7[/b]
Chapter 7 will be available in November!
It will be very different from the previous ones. Many of your decisions made in other chapters will be reflected in what you see here.
[*][b]Knowledge[/b]
Before Chapter 7 comes out, you will have an improved dialog system. There will be "knowledge" in the game. "Knowledge" can be obtained by reading notes, finding items to explore, or in dialogues. The acquired knowledge opens up additional answer options in the dialogues. 
Knowledge will appear in the game in the near future.
[*][b]Survival[/b]
I also plan to improve the survival elements. Food will play a more important role than now, and there will be campfires, resting near which will give the character various boosts.
[/list]
[b]That's all for now! Stay tuned!
[/b]
